patterns.pattern: Rebuild on the live PR head in a clean worktree, and pin the old local tip with an archive branch
patterns.context: The local branch had diverged from the PR head after the remote was rewritten
patterns.application: archive/pr4545-local-a0387bc21 preserved a0387bc21, which made the diverged branch disposable instead of something to merge

patterns.pattern: Split a policy change out of a correctness PR even when it is one line
patterns.context: Six unpublished commits, five of them behavior and test fixes
patterns.application: Cherry-picked five; left the Ruff baseline 43 to 31 change out, because changing main's ceiling is a separate review

patterns.pattern: Require mutation controls to fail on the restored defect
patterns.context: Verifying that new tests cover the fix rather than merely running beside it
patterns.application: Both restored defects failed their controls before the remediation was called done

avoidances.antipattern: Reading only the final diff to decide whether security review is required
avoidances.consequence: The root lefthook.yml change arrived through recovered commit dc7393d0b, so the PIV requirement is easy to miss
